Own-work period access and foreign-work refusals for every record.

Two prepared Legendary constraints; unverified packs remain closed even with a broad edition selection.
Eight real native strike commands from an injured fixture; no gun actions, ammunition, extra powers, model-specific healing or cryogenic status granted.

Three thermal bursts: real multi-hit damage, heat and subsequent cooling.
Three delayed explosions: one clip spent, no early damage, real main/splash impact.
Four charged profiles: native cancellation without emitted clips, release expenditure and delayed Venom area impact.
Reegar channel: real per-pulse ammunition and cancellation without refund or extra future hits.
Lookup rejects forged objects without getter execution or coercion.
